findings.issue: זֶה is a masculine singular demonstrative; «esta» is the feminine demonstrative, smoothed to the gender of «palabra».
מִמֻּתֵנוּ is comparative min plus a qal infinitive construct of «die» with a 1cp suffix («than our dying»); «nuestra muerte» turns that infinitive into the noun death.

notes: The interrogative, the word spoken to the 2ms, both Egipto roles, the cohortative, and the verbless «bueno a nosotros» stay inside the tokens.
